gate: Gate 2 — Final Post-Build Adversarial & Visual UX Audit

summary.overview: Production-ready PASS (0 P0, 0 P1, 5 non-blocking P2 polish/hardening notes). All Gate 1 P0 and P1 blockers were verified resolved in source and built dist/. Backend API endpoints enforce strict HTML escaping, constant-time webhook secret validation (401/403), strict admin ID whitelisting, mandatory unchecked CASL consent, honeypot rejection, photo mime/count/size caps, server-side quote recomputation, and Web Crypto SHA-256 Meta CAPI hashing. Static build passes every performance, SEO/GEO, secret-leak, and brand-compliance budget (9.40 KB gzip JS, 139.9 KB max image, 0 forbidden claims, 0 leaked secrets). All 4 live Chrome screenshots verified crisp typography, zero logo halo, pixel-accurate Room X-Ray pins, distraction-free /lp/move-out?promo=50 sync, and zero horizontal overflow on 390x844 mobile.

telegramHtmlXssEscaping.details: escapeTelegramHtml escapes &, <, >, ", ' on every untrusted field (leadId, name, phone, email, postalCode, areaName, serviceTitle, frequency, addons, preferredDate, notes, promo.appliedCode, attribution) before sending parse_mode: 'HTML'. sendPhoto captions omit parse_mode (plain text).

telegramWebhookSecretValidation.details: Rejects unconfigured TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET with 401, missing X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header with 401, and invalid token with 403 via constant-time XOR comparison (minor length-equality hardening noted in RT2-P2-02).

telegramAdminIdWhitelist.details: AUTHORIZED_TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS strictly locked to ['633982504', '332623386'] for both outbound lead alerts and inbound callback_query / /slots webhook commands; unauthorized senders receive HTTP 403.

mandatoryUncheckedCaslConsent.details: Checkbox renders unchecked by default; client blocks submit with accessible role='alert' banner (verified live in Chrome); server independently enforces body.caslSmsConsent === true (HTTP 400 if false/missing).

honeypotAndAttachmentCaps.details: Non-empty honeypot rejected with HTTP 400. Request Content-Length capped at 8,000,000 bytes; snapPhotos capped at <= 2 attachments, strict mime whitelist (image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp), max 2,500,000 base64 chars each; client Canvas downscales to <= 1024px JPEG <= 450,000 chars.

serverSideQuoteRecalculation.details: processLeadSubmission ignores any client-submitted totals and recomputes calculateQuote({ ...data.quoteInput, postalCode: data.postalCode }) strictly server-side, enforcing $95 CAD minimum floor and Move-Out free inclusions.

metaCapiSha256Hashing.details: Uses Web Crypto crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256') for normalized E.164 phone digits (ph), lowercased email (em), 3-char FSA (zp), country ('ca'), and external_id; forwards fbp/fbc/event_id for browser-server deduplication; skips cleanly when META_PIXEL_ID or META_CAPI_TOKEN is absent.

clientDomXssHygiene.details: Client scripts use textContent exclusively (zero innerHTML sinks). SeoHead.astro escapes '</' as '<\/' inside JSON-LD script tags to prevent script-tag breakout.

secretLeakAndComplianceScan.details: Scanned all 73 built dist/ files against 9 real repo .env values + generic Telegram/Meta/Google/OpenAI token regexes (0 leaks) and all 11 lock forbidden-claim patterns (0 matches). All 4 guides, Area Hubs, and Move-Out service copy pass full surface-safety compliance.

findings.title: Minor CTA pill line-wrapping in desktop seasonal banner and mobile 390px header brand truncation
findings.location: Top seasonal banner pills & mobile sticky header row
findings.impact: Purely cosmetic: at 1440px, 'Claim Holiday Slot ->' and 'Gift a Clean' wrap onto two lines inside their pills; at 390px, the mobile header's 'Instant Price' pill wraps and causes 'LevelUp Clean...' to truncate with ellipsis despite StickyMobileBar already providing 'Instant Price ->' at the bottom.
findings.fixInstructions: Add `whitespace-nowrap shrink-0` to the seasonal banner CTA links and optionally hide the mobile header 'Instant Price' button (`hidden sm:inline-flex`) so 'LevelUp Cleaning' renders untruncated on 390px viewports.

findings.title: Constant-time webhook secret check returns early on byte-length mismatch
findings.impact: Low practical risk over WAN (Cloudflare edge jitter masks nanosecond length differences), but hashing both strings with SHA-256 prior to fixed 32-byte XOR comparison eliminates theoretical length side-channel disclosure.
findings.fixInstructions: Optionally hash `a` and `b` via `crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', ...)` before running the constant-time 32-byte XOR loop.

findings.title: Telegram lead card scope line renders unclamped bedroom/bathroom counts from quoteInput
findings.impact: Zero XSS risk (numeric values only) and pricing is properly clamped 1..5 inside calculateQuote, but a crafted API payload with `bedrooms: 99` would display '99 Bed' in the Telegram admin card while quoting a 5-bedroom home.
findings.fixInstructions: Clamp `data.quoteInput.bedrooms` and `bathrooms` to `1..5` (matching `calculateQuote`) when formatting `scopeLine` in `formatTelegramLeadMessage`.

findings.title: CASL consent checkbox text formats phone as '+1 780-710-1503' instead of '+1 (780) 710-1503'
findings.impact: Cosmetic formatting difference vs canonical display string '+1 (780) 710-1503'.

findings.title: Placeholder LEVELUP_KV namespace IDs in wrangler.toml prior to Cloudflare production provisioning
findings.impact: Expected pre-deployment placeholder; `/api/slots` safely falls back to 3 slots without KV, but production Telegram `/slots <N>` persistence requires real KV namespace IDs.
findings.fixInstructions: Before Cloudflare Pages deploy, run `wrangler kv namespace create LEVELUP_KV`, update `id` and `preview_id` in `website/wrangler.toml`, and set `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `META_PIXEL_ID`, and `META_CAPI_TOKEN` via `wrangler pages secret put`.
